summary: Iteration 42 — Re-tested Company Plan Limits Enforcement frontend flow after main-agent fix that mounted <CompanyPlanUsageCard /> inside pages/CompanyAdminDashboard.js. Manual-open flow fully verified PASS (card + usage tiles render, upgrade-plan-btn opens the dialog with all 4 tiers). Auto-open via Axios 403 interceptor FAILS due to a NEW React runtime crash caused by the local `toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail)` catch-blocks in CompanyAdminDashboard.js passing the full detail OBJECT ({code, message, current_plan, current_plan_name_ar, current_count, max_allowed}) to sonner — which tries to render it as a React child and throws "Objects are not valid as a React child". This crashes the app overlay and prevents the auto-opened PlanUpgradeDialog from being visible.

ui_bugs.issue: After backend returns 403 with structured detail={code,message,...}, the createCompound/saveEdit/removeCompound/addUser catch blocks call `toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'فشل الإنشاء')`. When detail is an object (plan_limit_* errors), sonner tries to render the object as a React child → Uncaught React runtime error: 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {code, message, current_plan, current_plan_name_ar, current_count, max_allowed})'. The Axios 403 interceptor in GlobalUIProvider.js DID fire (network tab shows 403 response and react-hot-toast was invoked), but the subsequent React crash masks the auto-opened PlanUpgradeDialog.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot verify auto-open visually because local sonner toast.error receives an object and crashes React before the dialog becomes visible. Fix: in each catch block extract message safely, e.g. `const d = err.response?.data?.detail; toast.error(typeof d === 'object' ? (d?.message || 'فشل الإنشاء') : (d || 'فشل الإنشاء'));`. Once fixed, the GlobalUIProvider dispatched 'openUpgradeDialog' CustomEvent will mount <PlanUpgradeDialog /> without interference.

action_items: HIGH: In /app/frontend/src/pages/CompanyAdminDashboard.js, update ALL four catch blocks (createCompound L58, saveEdit L70, removeCompound L84, addUser L94) to extract .message from detail when it is an object. Example helper: `const errMsg = (e, fb) => { const d = e?.response?.data?.detail; return (d && typeof d === 'object') ? (d.message || fb) : (d || fb); };` and then `toast.error(errMsg(err, 'فشل الإنشاء'))`.

MEDIUM: Apply the same defensive pattern globally — grep for `toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail` across /app/frontend/src and fix all occurrences, because backend returns structured detail objects in multiple places now.

rca_of_the_issue: Backend /api/company-admin/compounds returns HTTP 403 with body {detail: {code:'plan_limit_compounds', message:'<arabic>', current_plan:'starter', current_plan_name_ar:'مجاني', current_count:1, max_allowed:1}}. (1) The global Axios interceptor in GlobalUIProvider.js correctly detects this shape, toasts detail.message via react-hot-toast, and dispatches `openUpgradeDialog` event → PlanUpgradeDialog mounts. (2) BUT the rejected Promise propagates to createCompound's catch in CompanyAdminDashboard.js line 58: `toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || 'فشل الإنشاء')`. Since detail is an object, sonner receives an object ReactNode and React throws 'Objects are not valid as a React child'. The resulting dev-overlay obscures the (already-mounted) PlanUpgradeDialog, making the auto-open flow appear broken. Fix at source (catch block extracts .message) resolves the UX; the interceptor itself is correct.
